# EXEMPTIONS FROM check-vocabulary.sh. One path prefix per line.

# It contains no content entries, and that is the point: every file in this tree
# documents itself in this project's own terms. If you find yourself adding one,
# the question to answer first is whether the wording is genuinely borrowed
# vocabulary (rewrite it) or MATHEMATICS or a person's name (the gate already
# permits both -- see the ALLOWED list in the script).
#
# The two entries below are the gate's own files, which necessarily contain the
# patterns they search for.
